messages:
Marta: Posted postmortem for the cache eviction cascade — repeating pattern across 3 incidents. Link: https://notion.redwood/pm/cache-cascade-2024
IncidentBot: Postmortem created by Marta. Please add remediation owners, timelines, and playbook updates.
Elliot: We should make the "first 5 minutes" checklist copy/paste friendly. Current runbook is too high-level.
Neha: I'll own runbook edits. Plan: add First-5 checklist, exact commands, expected signals, and an explicit escalation ladder.
Ravi: I'll draft a tiny wrapper for triggering fallbacks that does preflight checks and a lock. Will put it in infra-scripts.
Marta: dropping the commands I used during the incident so they can be included:
```
# check redis memory & evictions
kubectl -n inference exec -it svc/cache-inspect -- redis-cli INFO memory | egrep 'used_memory|evicted_keys'
# check cache hitrate (promql)
(sum(rate(cache_hits_total[1m])) by (svc)) / (sum(rate(cache_requests_total[1m])) by (svc))
# current fallback state (safe-read)
curl -sS -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://control.internal/api/v1/fallbacks | jq .status
# safe trigger (wrapper should run preflight)
curl -X POST https://control.internal/api/v1/fallbacks/trigger -d '{"mode":"graceful"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```
Connor: Safety note: last forced fallback caused cold-pool latency and a temporary error spike. Add a preflight: spare_capacity_pct > 10 AND error_rate_1m < 1% before running fallback.
Ravi: I'll implement the preflight (promql) and wrapper that acquires a lock file so concurrent runs don't overlap. Will test in staging.
Neha: owners/due dates: Runbook PR -> Neha (due 2024-11-12); Wrapper + preflight -> Ravi (due 2024-11-08); Safety test & Grafana panel -> Elliot (due 2024-11-10); Rollout coordination & tracker -> Marta (due 2024-11-11).
Marta: adding escalation ladder to the runbook draft: 1) page eng-oncall via PagerDuty 2) if no ack in 3 minutes escalate to eng-sre 3) if error rate > 5% for 10 minutes or latency > 300ms for 5 minutes -> page infra-leads. Note regional APAC variant: shorter timeouts.
Connor: also add an explicit "do not force fallback" warning unless preflight passes and owner confirms. Include expected side-effects so oncall knows what to expect.
Neha: will add a small "what to expect" section (cold pools, token-rate blips) and a rollback snippet to revert fallback mode.
Elliot: I'll author the Grafana panel for spare capacity and 1m error rate, then link it in the runbook. Will include exact PromQL for the preflight.
Marta: creating action items in tracker: https://go/repo/actions/55432. Please link PRs to that ticket and mention the action id in PR description.
IncidentBot: Follow-up check-in scheduled by Marta for 2024-11-13 09:30 (calendar invite sent). Reminder 48h prior.
Ravi: I'll open the PR for the wrapper + unit tests tomorrow and tag reviewers.
Neha: once runbook PR is up I'll assign reviewers and confirm owners in the tracker.
Connor: can we also add a recurring quarterly audit for cache playbooks? pattern is repeating.
Marta: done — added "quarterly playbook audit" to backlog with tag 'recurring-incidents'.
Elliot: will validate safety tests in staging and post results here before the check-in.
Neha: thanks everyone — aim to close remediation items within two sprints. :thumbsup:
